about: Blind A/B pairs against a target clip: A / B / Not sure / Neither, how much better, why (reason chips), unusable flags; Bradley-Terry ranking and play-off
question: Which version is better, judged against the target?
intro: One pair at a time. Play the target, then A and B. Pick A / B (keys 1, 2), Not sure (3) or Neither (4); say by how much and why. Mark a clip unusable if it is. Arrow keys move between pairs. Labels are hidden until you press Reveal. Autosaves; Submit when done.
